title: The Photograph
gist_ar: مشهد دراما: الخلاف مش على الصورة، الخلاف على إنه قال إنه حرقها، وإنها هي اللي فتّشت.

before_listening.en: A scene between two people. Almost nothing important is said directly. Listen for what they are REALLY arguing about.
before_listening.ar: مشهد بين شخصين. مفيش حاجة مهمة بتتقال بشكل مباشر. ركّز على هما بيتخانقوا على إيه فعلًا.

segments.speaker: Tarek
segments.text: Of course I kept it. Why would I throw it away?

segments.speaker: Mona
segments.text: Because you'd told me you had. That's why. In the car, on the way back from the hospital. You said you'd burnt everything.

segments.speaker: Tarek
segments.text: I said I'd burnt the letters.

segments.speaker: Tarek
segments.text: They were different. You know they were different. I'd been carrying those letters around for two years, and every time I read them I was worse afterwards. The photograph is just, it's the four of us on a beach. Nobody is angry in it.

segments.speaker: Mona
segments.text: That's exactly what's wrong with it. Sorry. That came out—

segments.speaker: Mona
segments.text: It's just that when I look at it, I don't see the four of us on a beach. I see the morning after. I see you standing in the kitchen not telling me. And I'd been asking you for a week. So when you keep it, and you put it in a drawer where I'd obviously find it—

segments.speaker: Tarek
segments.text: I didn't put it anywhere. It's been in that drawer since we moved. Mona. It's been in that drawer since we moved.

segments.speaker: Mona
segments.text: Do you remember what you actually said to me in that car?

segments.speaker: Mona
segments.text: That's not the same thing, and you know it isn't.

segments.speaker: Tarek
segments.text: No. It isn't. What I meant was, I'm not going to be the person who keeps a shrine. What I said was, I've burnt everything. Because the second one was shorter, and you were crying, and I wanted the conversation to be over.

segments.speaker: Mona
segments.text: It was over. For eight months it was completely over.

segments.speaker: Mona
segments.text: Fine. Then I'm the one who went looking.

gist_question.q: What are they really arguing about?
options: Whether the photograph should be thrown away
Whether he misled her, and whether she went looking for it
Which drawer the photograph belongs in

questions.q: What had Tarek actually said he had burnt?
questions.q_ar: طارق قال إنه حرق إيه بالظبط؟

questions.q: Why does the photograph upset Mona?
options: It reminds her of the morning after, not of the beach
She does not appear in it

questions.q: What does Mona concede at the end?
options: That she burnt the letters herself
That she was the one who went looking for it
That she never asked him anything

questions.q: How does Tarek explain the difference between what he meant and what he said?
questions.q_ar: طارق فسّر الفرق بين اللي قصده واللي قاله إزاي؟
options: He meant he would not keep a shrine, but said he had burnt everything because it was shorter
He meant that he had already burnt the photograph too
He says now that he meant nothing in particular
